changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'DomainCertificate') BEGIN create table [dbo].[DomainCertificate]( [ID] [int] identity(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [File] [varbinary](max) NOT NULL, [Password] [nvarchar](250) MASKED WITH (FUNCTION = 'default()') NULL, constraint [PK_DomainCertificate] primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) ) END
